description: Position of the single RVxF-type PP1 docking valine across human, mouse and rat LMTK1/AATK proteins, tested against V1175 reported in PMID:17267545
code:
import requests, re, time
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"aigr-curation-agent"})
EUT="https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/"
def up(a): return "".join(S.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=60).text.strip().split("\n")[1:])
def ncbi(a):
    t=S.get(EUT+"efetch.fcgi",params={"db":"protein","id":a,"rettype":"fasta","retmode":"text"},timeout=90).text
    return "".join(t.strip().split("\n")[1:]).upper()

seqs={
 "Q6ZMQ8-1 human (=NP_001073864.2)": up("Q6ZMQ8-1"),
 "Q6ZMQ8-3 human":                   up("Q6ZMQ8-3"),
 "Q6ZMQ8-2 human":                   up("Q6ZMQ8-2"),
 "NP_004911.2 human (not a UniProt isoform)": ncbi("NP_004911.2"),
 "Q80YE4 mouse (1365 aa)":           up("Q80YE4"),
 "NP_031403.2 mouse (1317 aa)":      ncbi("NP_031403.2"),
 "NP_001381515.1 rat (1370 aa)":     ncbi("NP_001381515.1"),
 "XP_006247989.1 rat (1321 aa)":     ncbi("XP_006247989.1"),
}
PP1=re.compile(r"[RK].{0,1}[VI].[FW]")
rec=[]
for k,s in seqs.items():
    m=PP1.search(s)
    vpos = (m.start()+3) if m else None   # V of K-A-V-S-F
    rec.append(dict(seq=k, length=len(s), motif=m.group(0) if m else None,
                    motif_start=m.start()+1 if m else None, V_position=vpos,
                    res1175=s[1174] if len(s)>=1175 else None))
df=pd.DataFrame(rec)
print(df.to_string(index=False))
print("\nGagnon 2007 (PMID:17267545) states 'a key valine residue (V1175)' in the PP1 docking motif of AATYK1.")
print("Sequences where V_position == 1175:", list(df.loc[df.V_position==1175,"seq"]))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,5.2))
d=df.dropna(subset=["V_position"]).copy()
d["delta"]=d["V_position"]-1175
y=np.arange(len(d))[::-1]
cols=["#2E7D32" if v==1175 else "#B0BEC5" for v in d["V_position"]]
ax.barh(y, d["V_position"], color=cols, height=0.55)
ax.axvline(1175, color="#C62828", lw=1.6, ls="--")
ax.text(1175, len(d)-0.3, "V1175 reported in PMID:17267545", color="#C62828", ha="right", va="bottom", fontsize=9)
for yi,(v,dd) in zip(y, zip(d["V_position"], d["delta"])):
    ax.text(v+8, yi, f"V{int(v)}  ({dd:+.0f})", va="center", fontsize=8.5)
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels(d["seq"], fontsize=8.5)
ax.set_xlabel("Position of the valine in the single KAVSF (RVxF-type) PP1 docking motif")
ax.set_title("Only the 1317 aa mouse LMTK1/AATYK1 protein places this valine at 1175", fontsize=11)
ax.set_xlim(0,1420); ax.spines[["top","right"]].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
